throughput.source_quote: Delta Petroleum Corporation is an E&P company; no crude refining throughput

warnings: CAUTION: This CIK (821483) was Delta Petroleum Corporation (E&P company) in this period, not a petroleum refiner. Notes to FY2004 financial statements explicitly state: 'As of June 30, 2004, the Company had no derivative instruments in place.' Realized net losses from hedging in FY2003 were $1.9M and FY2004 were $859K (unwinding prior contracts). No hedges active at fiscal year-end June 30, 2004.
